_about: BLIND evaluation set for the Forge text-to-part model (written 2026-11-04, after the pilots). Two halves: DEV may be used while iterating; TEST is touched ONCE per candidate, after the candidate is fixed, and its individual failures are not read before that choice. Brands here are in neither the training brand list nor the production brand filter; each brand item carries `brandTerms` for the scorer. Items map onto the existing eval sets: general/slot/edge -> heldout, brand/subtle-unsafe/inject -> redteam. UNREVIEWED: no native speaker has read it; fixed phrasings are hand-written translations; model-written wishes are filtered, not corrected; the subtle-unsafe expectation is not ground truth. Do not edit by hand: scripts/tuning/blind-set.ts rewrites the curated groups and refuses to change the model-written ones without --force-model.
